prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE square 1:1 fantasy RPG UI icon for a character's GAMEPLAY GUIDE button. Main motif: a charming chunky OPEN TACTICS BOOK with warm ivory parchment pages and a dark forest-green leather cover, modest antique gold corner fittings and a burgundy bookmark. A short silver sword and a wooden spear cross diagonally behind the book, visible tips at the upper corners and grips at the lower corners, integrated as one compact readable emblem. On the open pages just a few bold hand-inked tactical arrows and dots, NO writing, letters or numbers. Make the book the dominant shape and the crossed weapons secondary, readable when reduced to 80px. Use the supplied inventory images for ART STYLE ONLY, no copied house crest: hand-painted illustrated fantasy inventory art, crisp dark brown outlines, softly simplified shading, warm muted colors, gentle illustrated gold highlights, charming slightly playful proportions. Strong clear silhouette, slight three-quarter book perspective. Entire icon centered within a square with 8% clear margin. TRUE transparent PNG alpha background and transparent spaces between objects. No background disk, frame, scenery, floor, shadow, glow, text, labels, badge, hands, person, extra objects, photorealism or glossy 3D.
